name: Kovácsvágás (Hungary)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of blue, white and green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kovácsvágás: a blue shield with a tree and a stag, with grey mantling, above a scroll inscribed KOVÁCSVÁGÁS.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kovácsvágás arms with mantling and scroll
